scope: All saved scenarios in tests/evals/scenarios/: adding a product, a discount code, private orders and a page notice
assumptions: The local evaluation shop represents the site; each scenario starts in a fresh browser session
limitations: No credentials were supplied, so private orders could not be checked

scenarios.name: Add a product to the cart

steps.name: Press Add Ceramic Mug to cart

scenarios.name: Скидка в корзине

criteria.actual: Code accepted is shown under the discount code field
The total stays $12.00 after SAVE10 is accepted

steps.name: Press Add Ceramic Mug to cart
Press Apply code
steps.detail: Code accepted, but the total is unchanged

reproduction: Open the shop in a fresh session
Search for “mug” and add Ceramic Mug to the cart
Enter SAVE10 in Discount code and press Apply code
Code accepted appears, and Total still shows $12.00 instead of $10.80
